To optimize the Onimator Bot's functionality, it's recommended to enable gesture mode on your phone. This will disable the navigation bars that exist at the bottom of your screen, providing a more seamless experience. Here's how to enable gesture mode:

On Android: Go to Settings > System > Gestures > System navigation. Select "Gesture navigation" to enable it.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948649003155526/Screenshot_9.jpg?ex=67efa752&is=67ee55d2&hm=8dc1e6b7f4cf60e7d08f098d57b0b28188355d593c55d76bdc3ca3415710664d&

## 4. Hide Hints and Edge Panel

For an even smoother operation of the Onimator Bot, it's advisable to hide hints and disable the edge panel on your phone. This will prevent any accidental interactions that might interfere with the bot's operation. Here's how you can do it:

Hide Hints: On Android devices with gesture navigation, you can usually hide the gesture hints by going to Settings > Display > Navigation bar > Gesture settings. Turn off the "Gesture hints" option.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948740946624672/screenshot-6.jpg?ex=67efa768&is=67ee55e8&hm=a6591ed2611599f793ac4df233d84ede15b48cba725ba81c8b9b96fcc9e620db&

Disable Edge Panel: On Samsung devices, go to Settings > Display > Edge screen > Edge panels. Turn off the Edge panels toggle to disable this feature.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948820080431246/screenshot-5.jpg?ex=67efa77b&is=67ee55fb&hm=03250714492aac99d12c9fdf39abc61b0ad3237e0a6c6cfcfe80e431e4f98e4b&

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948397282136204/222.png?ex=67efa716&is=67ee5596&hm=a615c0cf0d7457a4350b180905c5c6fbd584ed322186827ca3de22d7c856d477&

d. Navigate to the location where the IGbot folder is saved, select it, and click "Select Folder" to confirm.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948471726702592/333.png?ex=67efa728&is=67ee55a8&hm=bbfde6b9bac49f90ab724a8063843d1975f9682ffcba353c2c4a54dc1d79a23f&

e. The IGbot folder will now appear in the list of exclusions and Windows Defender will not scan this folder in the future.

By setting this exclusion, you can keep real-time protection enabled while ensuring that the IGbot operates without interruptions from the antivirus software.

## 2. Set Language to English

The Onimator Bot is designed to work exclusively with the English language interface. To ensure compatibility and avoid any issues, you should set the language of your phone or emulator to English. Here's how you can do it:

On Android: Go to Settings > System > Languages & input > Languages. Add English (if it's not already added) and set it as the primary language by dragging it to the top of the list.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948544758190131/Screenshot_7.jpg?ex=67efa739&is=67ee55b9&hm=36e635c961925f19798fec690d05fdeeba3943e8afc1b5118af0801886696f3e&

## 3. Enable Gesture Mode

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948176816935003/screenshot_4.png?ex=67efa6e1&is=67ee5561&hm=c8cb40f7b35df1d89e796f8ea5e0bcd0dd5a4507b538283793647d556dfd8bc0&

**Step 5: Confirm the Action**
A warning message will appear stating that your device will be vulnerable to threats. Click "Yes" to confirm that you want to disable real-time protection.

**Important Considerations**
- Real-time protection might automatically reactivate if you restart your computer. Please ensure it is disabled before running the Bot again.
- If you have any antivirus software installed, please ensure it is disabled as well.

**Step 6: Exclude IGbot Folder from Windows Defender**
If you do not want to disable real-time protection completely or if it reactivates after a restart, you can exclude the IGbot folder from being scanned by Windows Defender. This will prevent the bot from being incorrectly flagged as a threat.

Here's how to set an exclusion for the IGbot folder:

a. Open Windows Security and navigate to "Virus & threat protection" as before.
b. Under "Virus & threat protection settings", click on "Add or remove exclusions."

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948317128851536/111.png?ex=67efa703&is=67ee5583&hm=c652d95c438e67b88460438baee0ef49c2b49ea194fcc596d8a364718bcf640f&

c. Click on "Add an exclusion" and select "Folder" from the dropdown menu.

# ⭐ TIP 3: Essential Steps Before Using Onimator Bot

## 1. Disable Real-Time Protection on Windows

When using the Onimator Bot on Windows, it is recommended to disable the built-in antivirus software, Windows Defender's real-time protection, before running the bot. This is to avoid any potential issues where the software might mistakenly identify the bot as malware and block its operation. Here's how you can disable real-time protection:

**Step 1: Open Windows Security**
Windows 10/11: Click on the Start menu, type "Windows Security" in the search bar, and select the app from the results.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217947855151566939/screenshot_1.png?ex=67efa695&is=67ee5515&hm=02ecc667969e3b782fbfc20bfc87db432f319568a8267febc45fe97c23389d30&

**Step 2: Navigate to Virus & Threat Protection**
Once you have opened the Windows Security app, click on "Virus & threat protection" from the left-hand side menu.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217947974567596184/screenshot_2.png?ex=67efa6b1&is=67ee5531&hm=1f437e4ee9ff4a77eab080d0fa087025263861298a14e713024d0e5bed2aadf0&

**Step 3: Manage Settings**
Scroll down to the "Virus & threat protection settings" section and click on "Manage settings."

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1217948047397490780/screenshot_3.png?ex=67efa6c2&is=67ee5542&hm=86e038e3118e8540ab6b28e4da4a1c973afe8bf97daeb7dfe1acbf77b6d61ec7&

**Step 4: Turn Off Real-Time Protection**
You will see a toggle switch for "Real-time protection." Click on it to turn it off. A User Account Control (UAC) prompt may appear asking for permission to make changes. Click "Yes" to proceed.

# ⭐ TIP 2: Resolving IGBot Crashing Issue

**A Step-by-Step Guide to Fixing TypeError in Post-Liking Function**

Sometimes, while performing actions, the IGBot may crash. For example, as you can see in the error below, IGBot crashes at the point of deciding whether to like posts or not. This results in the Instagram application crashing. The error encountered is as follows:

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1215035448494133268/crash_issue_1.jpg?ex=67ef9a31&is=67ee48b1&hm=f00a1b102aeae1785cba7a589e81cb0d30bbd626c3ac7e8d9166586a7fb64bf6&

**Steps to resolve the issue:**

**1. Locate the Database File:** The issue might be related to a corrupted user database file. Navigate to the IGBot folder where the iguserdatabase.db file is located. This file contains user-related data that the bot uses to perform actions.

**2. Rename the Database File:** To resolve the issue, you need to reset the user database. Do this by renaming the iguserdatabase.db file to iguserdatabase_old.db. This will force the bot to create a new database file and start fresh.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1215035645504786472/crash_issue_2.png?ex=67ef9a60&is=67ee48e0&hm=234ea49edde4c48299a540d30bfcbeb672845c0826076471fec13d64df0dc5fb&

**3. Restart the Bot:** After renaming the database file, restart the IGBot. The bot should now create a new iguserdatabase.db file and initialize it with default values.

**4. Monitor the Bot:** Observe the bot's behavior after the fix. It should now be able to decide whether to like posts without crashing. If the issue persists, please create a ticket so we can investigate the issue.

5. **Click SAVE**.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1209114451710574593/1209119430777249862/save.png?ex=67efd538&is=67ee83b8&hm=62b34a7dc5075c3db09c15f4614200340b47b90c981b97dc767aa84f6bf65b11&

That way, when the bot can't find Instagram users that match the names you have added in the first option, it will follow any other users except the ones with the names you add in this option.
